name: best.opendata.x402/web-intelligence
title: OpenData Best Web Intelligence (x402 USDC)
description: 99 real-time structured web data APIs (172 tools) paid per row in USDC on Base via x402 v2.

tools.name: agoda_com__search
tools.description: [Agoda Hotels Prices Rooms and Reviews Data] Search Agoda hotels, rooms and guest reviews. Query Agoda accommodation prices, ratings, room offers and optional guest reviews by city name or Agoda URL. x402 price: $0.0050/row USDC (max 20 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

destination.description: A city name such as Chiang Mai, Seoul or Tokyo, in a language Agoda recognizes. A name that is not recognized as a city returns no rows; hotel page URLs, a city page URL or a city ID take precedence.

regionId.description: Numeric Agoda city ID, such as 9395 for Bangkok. Used instead of destination, unless hotel page URLs or a city page URL are set.

cityPageUrl.description: Agoda city page URL, such as https://www.agoda.com/city/bangkok-th.html. Returns listed hotels without dated prices; takes precedence over destination and regionId, but not detailUrls.

detailUrls.description: Up to 20 distinct Agoda hotel page URLs, such as https://www.agoda.com/asia-hotel-bangkok/hotel/bangkok-th.html. These take precedence over other targets; readable pages return hotel rows, with dated prices when available and optional review rows.

checkin.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to use 21 days from today.

checkout.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format, 1 to 30 nights after check-in. Leave empty to use two nights after check-in. Stays above 14 nights discover hotels with a 14-night window and price the full stay.

children.description: Number of children, from 0 to 10. Optional childAges can specify each child's age.

childAges.description: Optional ages in years for each child (0-17). When set, provide one entry per child.

maxResults.description: Most rows for each destination search, city page URL, or hotel page URL. Default 70; larger numbers are collected in parts of 70. Hotels, reviews and room variants count together. The whole run stops at your maximum total charge. Free platform plan: up to 200 rows per run and 10 runs of this Actor.

enrichDetails.description: Add descriptions, amenities, FAQs and available address details to the first search-result hotels. Guest reviews are separate rows only when includeReviews is enabled.

enrichLimit.description: Number of search-result hotels to enrich, from 0 to 20. Direct hotel page inputs are read separately from this setting.

includeReviews.description: Return each available guest review as a separate billed row. Hotel and review rows share maxResults; this also enables hotel details.

includeSponsored.description: Keep hotels Agoda marks as sponsored.

includeRooms.description: Return each sellable room variant (room type, bed configuration, price plan) as a separate billed row, in addition to hotel and review rows. Room rows share maxResults.

domain.description: Agoda site, such as www.agoda.com, www.agoda.co.th or www.agoda.co.jp. A supported country site determines the language and currency.

locale.description: Language and currency setting on www.agoda.com, such as en-us for USD or ja-jp for JPY. A supported country site overrides this setting.

tools.name: airbnb_com__search
tools.description: [Airbnb Stays Listings Prices and Reviews Data] Search Airbnb stays, pricing and listing details. Query Airbnb vacation rentals, prices, ratings, capacity and public host details by destination or listing URL. x402 price: $0.0050/row USDC (max 20 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

destination.description: City, region, or country to search (e.g. Osaka, Paris, Bali). Fill this, startUrls, or detailUrls. Leave all three empty to run a small example search for Singapore (3 rows).

startUrls.description: Optional Airbnb search links (any Airbnb country site, e.g. https://www.airbnb.com/s/Paris/homes). When set, destination is not used to build the search; pages are still followed up to maxResults.

detailUrls.description: Optional Airbnb listing links like https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/12345 (any Airbnb country site). When set, the search is skipped and up to detailEnrichLimit listing pages are read. Requires enrichDetails=true.

listingIds.description: Optional numeric Airbnb listing IDs (for example 46416127 or 1775492715633747148). When set, search is skipped and up to detailEnrichLimit listings are collected.

maxResults.description: Most rows for each destination, category tag, start URL, or detail URL. Default 70; larger numbers are collected in parts of 70. All row types count together. The whole run stops at your maximum total charge. Free platform plan: up to 200 rows per run and 10 runs of this Actor (limits set by the Actor developer).

market.description: Airbnb storefront used for the search. Sets the default domain, language and currency; it does not restrict results to that country.

checkin.description: Check-in date (year-month-day). Leave both dates empty for a flexible-date search (prices are then per night).

checkout.description: Check-out date (year-month-day), after check-in. Leave both dates empty for a flexible-date search.

pets.description: Number of pets traveling with guests.

roomTypes.description: Choose one or more room types; matching any selected type is sufficient. Leave empty for all room types.

categoryTags.description: Choose category labels such as Beach or Cabins; Tag:NNNN codes are also accepted. Each category has its own maxResults allowance, and duplicate listings are removed.

propertyTypeIds.description: Property type filters (property_type_id[]). Choose labels and/or numeric IDs.

priceMin.description: Optional minimum nightly price in the active currency.

priceMax.description: Optional maximum nightly price in the active currency.

bounds.description: Optional geographic bounding box object with neLat, neLng, swLat and swLng coordinates to search a specific map area.

enrichDetails.description: Add public host, location, amenity and rating details to up to detailEnrichLimit listings.

detailEnrichLimit.description: Maximum number of listings selected for detail enrichment, from 1 to 50. Listings not checked retain empty detail fields with not_verified reasons.

reviewsLimit.description: Maximum reviews fetched per enriched listing, newest first. Zero disables reviews unless Detail extras includes reviews, which then fetches up to 24.

reviewRows.description: Deliver each review as its own row (rowType review) instead of a reviews list inside the listing row. Each review row is charged as a result and counts against Max results, so fewer listings fit in the same budget.

detailExtras.description: Optional additions to an enriched listing: detailApi for additional listing details, reviews, policies, priceBreakdown for dated prices, hostProfile for public host facts, and calendar for availability when supported. rooms delivers each bookable room of a multi-room property as its own row (rowType room), charged as a result and counted against Max results. Reviews stay inside the listing row unless Reviews as rows is on; similarListings is retired and ignored.

domain.description: Optional Airbnb storefront address, such as www.airbnb.jp. Leave empty to use the market default.

locale.description: Optional storefront language, such as ja-JP. Leave empty to use the market default.

currency.description: Optional three-letter price currency, such as USD, JPY or EUR. Leave empty to use the market default.

placeId.description: Optional known place identifier to refine the search location. Leave empty if you do not have one.

tools.name: alibaba_1688_com__search
tools.description: [1688 Global Wholesale and Suppliers] Search wholesale products or browse rankings. Wholesale offer rows from keyword search or category rankings. Leave mode on auto or select ranking with categoryId. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

mode.description: Auto selects detail for product URLs or offer IDs, supplier for member IDs, and search for a keyword. Select ranking explicitly to collect a ranking tab without a keyword.

keyword.description: Enter one product phrase, preferably in English for the Global catalog. Leaving all target fields empty starts the three-row phone case example, with normal charges.

startUrls.description: Enter 1688 product URLs containing /offer/<number>.html or an offerId query parameter. Shop and category URLs are not product targets.

sortBy.description: Sort order for Global keyword search results.

minPrice.description: Optional lower USD price bound for Global keyword search.

maxPrice.description: Optional upper USD price bound for Global keyword search.

minOrderQuantity.description: Optional minimum order quantity filter for Global keyword search.

supplierFilter.description: Filter Global keyword search results by verified 1688 supplier tier.

certifications.description: Optional certification filters for Global keyword search, such as CE, RoHS, FCC, UL, UKCA, KC, or PSE.

rankingName.description: Choose the ranking tab to read when mode is ranking. Trending is the older name of TRENDING; Most orders in the last 30 days was merged into Most_Popular. Rows keep the name you chose in rankingName and the tab read in rankingCode.

categoryId.description: Enter the numeric category ID used by the ranking page, such as 54.

categoryLevel.description: Category depth for the ranking filter, from 1 to 3.

countryCode.description: Two-letter country filter for rankings, such as CN or US. This does not change the search market.

maxPages.description: Number of Global search pages to check, from 1 to 5. Collection can stop sooner when the requested row limit is reached.

includeDetails.description: Add available product specifications, SKU prices, images, shipping and ratings to search or ranking rows. Enabled by default; CNY details do not overwrite USD search prices.

maxDetailItems.description: Maximum search or ranking rows to enrich with details, up to 20 and no more than maxResults. Use at least 1 when includeDetails is enabled; direct detail mode attempts all selected products.

includeLeads.description: Add available supplier contacts and company fields to product rows; defaults to includeDetails. Supplier mode always attempts supplier information.

maxLeadItems.description: Maximum search or ranking rows to enrich with supplier information, up to 100 and no more than maxResults. Defaults to maxDetailItems; supplier mode attempts all selected suppliers.

maxResults.description: Most rows to deliver for each keyword, product ID or supplier member ID, from 1 to 100; default 70. Your maximum charge limits the whole run; Free platform plan users are limited by the developer to 200 rows per run and 10 runs of this Actor.

tools.name: alibaba_1688_com__products
tools.description: [1688 Global Wholesale and Suppliers] Wholesale offer details by offer ID or URL. Detailed offer rows (with optional SKU, contact, DSR, similar and review rows) for given 1688 offerIds or URLs. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

offerIds.description: Enter numeric 1688 product IDs, such as the digits in detail.1688.com/offer/123456789.html. Direct details retain their source language and CNY prices.

startUrls.description: Enter 1688 product URLs containing /offer/<number>.html or an offerId query parameter. Shop and category URLs are not product targets.

includeDescription.description: Include available product description text and images when collecting product details.

includeContactInfo.description: Attempt additional published landline and fax details. Requires includeLeads; unavailable contacts remain empty.

includeSku.description: Fetch the standalone SKU selector surface for enriched product rows when available.

includeReviews.description: Add buyer reviews of each enriched product as rows of their own (recordType review). Review rows share each input's maxResults with the product rows and are charged like any row: one offer ID with maxResults 3 gives the product and up to two reviews.

includeDsr.description: Fetch detailed store rating tags and fulfillment scores for enriched product rows.

includeSimilar.description: Fetch comparable offer data on enriched product rows when available.

includeRecommend.description: Fetch store recommendation metadata on enriched product rows when available.

maxResults.description: Most rows to deliver for each keyword, product ID or supplier member ID, from 1 to 100; default 70. Your maximum charge limits the whole run; Free platform plan users are limited by the developer to 200 rows per run and 10 runs of this Actor.

tools.name: alibaba_1688_com__suppliers
tools.description: [1688 Global Wholesale and Suppliers] Supplier company profiles by member ID or URL. Supplier rows for given 1688 memberIds or company profile URLs. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

memberIds.description: Enter supplier member IDs, including b2b- IDs or older alphanumeric IDs. Do not enter shop URLs.

startUrls.description: Enter 1688 product URLs containing /offer/<number>.html or an offerId query parameter. Shop and category URLs are not product targets.

includeContactInfo.description: Attempt additional published landline and fax details. Requires includeLeads; unavailable contacts remain empty.

includeDsr.description: Fetch detailed store rating tags and fulfillment scores for enriched product rows.

maxResults.description: Most rows to deliver for each keyword, product ID or supplier member ID, from 1 to 100; default 70. Your maximum charge limits the whole run; Free platform plan users are limited by the developer to 200 rows per run and 10 runs of this Actor.

tools.name: allovoisins_com__search
tools.description: [AlloVoisins France Local Services Data] Search AlloVoisins France local service providers. Query AlloVoisins local service providers, categories, rental directories and SIRET registry details across France. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 20 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

searchType.description: Leave Auto selected to choose a mode from your URLs, profiles, intent, category or city. Or pick a directory, catalog, company or public demand-preview mode to collect it without a target.

citySlug.description: City identifier for category or crawl mode; category mode uses lille when omitted. Paris is supported: paris (mapped automatically to paris-75) and paris-1er-arrondissement to paris-20e-arrondissement, alongside all French communes such as lille, lyon, marseille, toulouse or nice. In api mode, append a postal code for same-name communes, such as saint-denis-93200.

categorySlug.description: Service identifier for category or crawl mode. All 258 AlloVoisins categories are accepted, including the 156 /v/ service subcategories and common French trade names such as plombier, jardinier, femme-de-menage or bricolage-petits-travaux. The fallback is femme-de-menage.

intentSlug.description: Service intent identifier from a /v/si/ URL, such as entretien-de-jardin. Select intent mode or leave searchType on Auto.

profileSlugs.description: Profile identifiers copied from real AlloVoisins /p/ URLs. Auto selects profile mode when this is your highest-priority target.

detailUrls.description: Supported AlloVoisins profile, service, rental, company, directory, sitemap or public metadata URLs. The page path determines what is collected.

maxResults.description: Most rows for each profile slug or detail URL; modes without a list have one input. Default 70; larger numbers are collected in parts of 70. Neighbor, profile, company, and other row types count together. The whole run stops at your maximum total charge. Free platform plan: up to 200 rows per run and 10 runs of this Actor.

market.description: France is the only supported market. Use fr for AlloVoisins.com.

enrichDetails.description: Add available profile information, such as SIRET and locality, to provider rows without adding a separate provider row. Private contact details are not revealed; company contacts require company-page modes.

enrichCompanyRegistry.description: When a professional row exposes a 14-digit SIRET (requires Enrich details or Profile mode), attach official French corporate registry data (SIREN, VAT number, NAF code, employee bracket, creation date, RGE certifications, directors and headquarters coordinates).

includeReviews.description: Add one separately billed row per review after its provider row, sharing the same maxResults limit. Reviews require profile collection or enrichDetails=true on provider lists.

maxReviewsPerProvider.description: Optional cap on review rows emitted per provider (1 to 50) when Include reviews is enabled, preventing a single profile from consuming your maxResults budget.

reviewsCutoffDate.description: Optional earliest review date in YYYY-MM-DD format when Include reviews is enabled. Older reviews are skipped.

offset.description: Number of rows to skip in list modes. Continue with diagnostics.searchMeta.nextOffset from RUN_SUMMARY until it is null.

maxPages.description: Maximum pages for provider lists or the commune crawl, from 1 to 50. Provider pagination uses /page/{n} and stops on an empty or duplicate page.

tools.name: amazon_com__search
tools.description: [Amazon Products Search and Best Sellers] Search Amazon products or browse Best Sellers and Movers. Product and ranking rows across 23 Amazon marketplaces by keywords, category or browse surface. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

mode.description: Choose the collection mode, or leave auto to infer it from detail URLs, keywords, category targets, or search seeds. Search-term mode returns suggestions rather than products.

keywords.description: Amazon search keywords, one per line (up to 20). Fill this for keyword search. Optional for category mode (search within a category).

seedKeywords.description: Optional starting terms for searchSeed mode, up to 20. When left empty the Actor returns built-in department terms (marked source=builtin, verified=false); each returned row is billed like any other result. When seeds are given but suggestions cannot be fetched, the run fails instead of substituting built-ins.

market.description: Amazon storefront to query.

postalCode.description: Optional marketplace delivery postal or ZIP code (for example 10001 for US or 100-0001 for JP) used to anchor local currency, BuyBox price, and domestic shipping text.

category.description: Department key such as electronics, books, or kitchen. For category or ranking modes, provide this field or a compatible browse node or ranking slug.

categoryNodeId.description: Optional browse node from the selected Amazon storefront. Overrides the department's mapped node.

categorySlug.description: Optional ranking category path, such as electronics. Overrides the department's mapped ranking path.

sort.description: Sort keyword or category search results. Ranking and detail modes ignore this setting.

condition.description: Item condition facet for keyword/category search. Not supported for bestsellers/newreleases/detail.

minPrice.description: Minimum price for keyword or category search in the selected storefront's currency. Ranking and detail modes ignore this setting.

maxPrice.description: Maximum price for keyword or category search in the selected storefront's currency. Ranking and detail modes ignore this setting.

pages.description: Maximum result pages for each input, from 1 to 20. Collection may stop sooner at the row or cost limit.

scrapeDetails.description: Enable product-detail enrichment of listing rows. On by default; seller enrichment also requires enrichDetails and a positive enrichMaxItems value.

enrichDetails.description: Add available seller business information to product rows. On by default; enrichment does not create a separate seller row.

enrichMaxItems.description: Maximum number of search/list rows to enrich with extra product detail and offer fetches when enrichDetails is enabled. Default keeps runs fast; raise for deeper variation/offer coverage.

maxResults.description: Maximum product rows delivered and billed per input (a keyword, a detail URL, a category or ranking target is one input). Default 70; larger numbers are collected in parts of 70. All row types count together. The whole run stops at your maximum total charge. Free platform plan runs are capped automatically at 200 rows. Alias: maxItems.

tools.name: amazon_com__products
tools.description: [Amazon Products Search and Best Sellers] Product details by ASIN or URL. Detailed Amazon product rows for given ASINs or detailUrls. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

asins.description: Optional list of 10-character Amazon ASINs (for example B07684BPLB). Each ASIN is resolved to a product detail URL on the selected marketplace.

detailUrls.description: Amazon product links (/dp/ASIN) or seller profile links (/sp?seller=ID) on the chosen market's site, e.g. https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0ABCD1234. Fill this to fetch those pages (detail mode).

market.description: Amazon storefront to query.

postalCode.description: Optional marketplace delivery postal or ZIP code (for example 10001 for US or 100-0001 for JP) used to anchor local currency, BuyBox price, and domestic shipping text.

scrapeDetails.description: Enable product-detail enrichment of listing rows. On by default; seller enrichment also requires enrichDetails and a positive enrichMaxItems value.

enrichDetails.description: Add available seller business information to product rows. On by default; enrichment does not create a separate seller row.

maxResults.description: Maximum product rows delivered and billed per input (a keyword, a detail URL, a category or ranking target is one input). Default 70; larger numbers are collected in parts of 70. All row types count together. The whole run stops at your maximum total charge. Free platform plan runs are capped automatically at 200 rows. Alias: maxItems.

tools.name: angi_com__search
tools.description: [Angi US Contractors and Cost Guides] Search Angi US contractor listings and cost guides. Query Angi service providers, ratings, reviews and local project cost guides by category, postal code or location. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

searchType.description: Choose US contractor search (fast), project cost guides, near-me listings, supported profiles, company pages, catalogs or sitemaps. Map, city hub, quote request and other Angi country-domain modes are not available.

detailUrls.description: Supported Angi or international marketplace page URLs, including profiles and company pages. URLs take priority over search settings; a US profile can produce a contractor row plus separate review rows within the row limit.

slice.description: Built-in service or city choice such as us/plumbing or ca/toronto; a bare name uses the selected market. It replaces the US category or international city, but does not change searchType.

category.description: Service slug or trade name, such as hvac, roofing or plumbing. For US search, 250+ trades resolve to the right categoryId automatically when categoryId is omitted.

categoryId.description: Optional numeric category for US search. 250+ US service categories (such as hvac, roofing, plumbing, electrical, landscaping) resolve automatically from category or query when categoryId is omitted.

postalCode.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4; an explicit ZIP takes priority over city and region. 10001 is used only when no postalCode, zipCodes, location or city is provided.

zipCodes.description: Optional list of 5-digit US ZIP codes to search across within maxResults (e.g. ['78701', '78702']).

location.description: Convenience location such as 'Austin, TX' or '78701' when postalCode is empty.

city.description: US city used with optional region when postalCode is omitted or empty, or the source site city slug for intl-list. An explicit postalCode takes priority for US searches.

region.description: US state code or name, such as WA, used with city when postalCode is empty. A region without a city or ZIP is not accepted.

query.description: Trade or task text. For US search it resolves the service category when category is empty; for cost-guide it is the project (e.g. roof replacement); for catalog it selects entries.

serviceProSlug.description: Single merchant slug for searchType=intl-service-pro (e.g. 217845-new-canadian-drain-plumbing-ltd). Leave empty to enumerate the market's ServicePro directory instead of fetching one merchant.

market.description: Select the marketplace: Angi in the US; HomeStars in Canada; MyBuilder in the UK; MyHammer in Germany or Austria; Travaux in France; Werkspot in the Netherlands; Instapro in Italy.

maxResults.description: Maximum rows for each category/ZIP search or detail URL, from 1 to 70. Default 70; contractor and review rows share this allowance. The whole run also stops at your maximum total charge. Free platform plan users have developer-set limits of 200 rows per run and 10 runs of this Actor.

maxPages.description: No longer used. Delivered rows follow maxResults only.

wantsPhone.description: For US search, ask the gateway for its contact field block. On requests large enough to cover a full result page the gateway returns a shared call-tracking number per business (not a direct line). Off by default; only applies to US category search.

ssaFilter.description: Limit US category search to businesses with the Super Service Award. This filter does not apply to other modes.

enrichDetails.description: Add available public profile fields to listing rows. Off by default; inaccessible profiles can leave the original listing unchanged.

mergeNearmeStreets.description: Off by default so US search runs on the fast JSON path. Enable to overlay published street addresses from matching near-me pages.

catalogKind.description: For catalog, select categories, algolia-tasks, xm-categories, costguide-categories, businessHighlights, featureflags or platformConfig. For sitemap, select category-sitemap, nearme-sitemap, pro-pool, statecat-sitemap, topic-sitemap, article-sitemap or leaf-index; pro-pool returns profile URLs, not profile content.

sitemapShard.description: Provider sitemap part from 1 to 72, used with searchType=sitemap and catalogKind=pro-pool. The first part is used when omitted.

harvestSeeds.description: Save service slugs, cities and category IDs discovered during the run for later reuse. Off by default; this does not guarantee additional output rows.

tools.name: apartments_com__search
tools.description: [Apartments.com US Rentals Units and Fees] Search US Apartments.com rental listings. Query US rental property listings, floorplans and unit fees by city, start URLs and rent/bed/bath filters. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

location.description: Enter one US city and state, such as Austin, TX. Start URLs take priority when both fields are supplied.

startUrls.description: Enter Apartments.com search, listing, or sitemap URLs, including URLs on its subdomains. These are used instead of Location.

propertyType.description: Select a rental property category. The default ('apartments') returns all rental types in the area; choose 'apartments_only', 'houses', 'condos', 'townhomes', or 'rooms' to filter by category.

maxPages.description: Optional page limit from 1 to 18. Leave at the default for normal runs; increasing this does not increase the row allowance.

scrapeDetails.description: Basic listing details are already requested in normal runs. Enable this to apply maxDetailFailRatio after at least two detail attempts.

includeUnits.description: Add separate floorplan and available unit rows with parent listing identity and location. Each row is billed and counts toward maxItems.

minRent.description: Only return listings with monthly rent at or above this amount in US dollars.

maxRent.description: Only return listings with monthly rent at or below this amount in US dollars.

minBeds.description: Minimum number of bedrooms, from 0 to 10. Use 0 for Studio.

maxBeds.description: Maximum number of bedrooms, from 0 to 10.

minBaths.description: Minimum number of bathrooms, from 0 to 10. Half baths such as 1.5 are allowed.

maxBaths.description: Maximum number of bathrooms, from 0 to 10.

minSqft.description: Minimum floor area in square feet.

maxSqft.description: Maximum floor area in square feet.

petPolicy.description: Only return listings that match this pet policy.

amenities.description: Amenity codes that listings must offer. Examples: "WASHER_DRYER", "AIR_CONDITIONING", "DISHWASHER", "BALCONY", "POOL", "GYM", "PARKING", "GARAGE_PARKING", "HARDWOOD_FLOORS", "EV_CHARGING", "FURNISHED", "GATED", "WALK_IN_CLOSETS", "DOG_PARK".

optionFlags.description: Named listing flags to require. Examples: "noBrokerFee", "isNew", "isForRentByOwner", "isNewConstruction", "rentByRoom", "acceptingApplications", "hasVideo", "has3DTour", "hasInPersonTour", "hasSelfGuidedLiveVideoTour".

minRating.description: Minimum overall property rating, from 1 to 5.

renterRating.description: Minimum renter review rating, from 1 to 5.

schoolRatingMin.description: Minimum rating of nearby schools, from 1 to 10.

schoolLevels.description: School levels to apply the school rating to: "elementary", "middle", "high".

moveInDate.description: Latest move-in date, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

availableOnMin.description: Earliest date a unit becomes available, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

availableOnMax.description: Latest date a unit becomes available, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

minLeaseMonths.description: Minimum rental term in months, from 1 to 60.

maxLeaseMonths.description: Maximum rental term in months, from 1 to 60.

minYearBuilt.description: Earliest year the building was built.

maxYearBuilt.description: Latest year the building was built.

keywords.description: Free-text keywords to match in listing text.

radiusMiles.description: Search radius around the location in miles, from 0.1 to 100.

includePhotos.description: Request listing photos and available neighborhood, language, and other listing information. Some listings may not provide these fields.

includeFees.description: Request property, floorplan, and unit fees when available. Also enables available floorplan and unit rows, each billed and counted toward maxItems.

includeWalkscore.description: Request available walking, transit, and cycling scores and their descriptions.

includeReviews.description: Add separate review rows with parent listing identity and location. Each review row is billed and counts toward maxItems.

includeFeatures.description: Request available community and unit feature lists.

includePropertyMap.description: Request available property-map information. Not every listing supplies a map.

includeRentCalendar.description: Request available move-in rent-calendar information for up to rentCalendarMaxUnits units per listing. Also enables floorplan and unit rows, each billed and counted toward maxItems.

includeSubmarket.description: Request available submarket names, identifiers, and geographic information.

includeTours.description: Request available tour types, settings, dates, and unit virtual-tour links. Also enables floorplan and unit rows, each billed and counted toward maxItems.

rentCalendarMaxUnits.description: Maximum units per listing to request rent-calendar information for, from 1 to 10. Only applies when rent calendars are requested.

commute.description: Optional object with latitude, longitude, commuteMinutes, and transportationMethod (1 car, 2 transit, 3 bicycle, 4 walking). Filtering uses an enclosing area rather than an exact travel-time boundary, and listings without coordinates can remain.

geog.description: Optional Apartments.com geographic object with type, id, box, and c values. Leave empty to search by Location or Start URLs.

geogSlice.description: Leave empty. Used only by the developer for testing.

sort.description: Optional sort order. Supported values: "default", "lowest_rent", "newest", "highest_rent", "has_video", "has_3d_tour", "recently_updated". Leave empty for the source order.

maxResults.description: Maximum rows per location or Start URL, from 1 to 200; default 70. Listings, floorplans, units, and reviews count together, subject to your total cost limit and the free-plan limit of 200 rows per run and 10 runs.

tools.name: apps_apple_com__search
tools.description: [Apple App Store Apps and Reviews] Search apps and browse charts, today, games, apps or arcade. App rows from a keyword search, App Store URLs or shelf modes (charts, today, games, apps, arcade). Leave mode on auto to pick the mode from the target you fill. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 20 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

mode.description: What to collect. Auto picks the mode from the fields you fill in (start URL > app id > developer id > collection id > search term). Shelf and chart modes (charts, today, games, apps, arcade) need no other field.

term.description: Search term, e.g. calendar. Used by search mode; filling only this field runs a search.

startUrls.description: App Store URLs for search, charts, apps, developers, reviews or collections; each URL determines its page type. Include the storefront, and include a platform for search URLs, such as https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/search?term=notes.

brand.description: Brand to request as a listing filter. Filter support depends on the selected page.

minPrice.description: Minimum listing price to request, in euros.

maxPrice.description: Maximum listing price to request, in euros.

condition.description: Request new, used or refurbished products where the listing supports this filter.

shipToCountry.description: Delivery destination to record with results from the French catalog. This does not select another catalog or guarantee that an offer ships there.

currency.description: Prices use EUR when a price is available. Other currency values do not convert prices.

page.description: Listing page to start from, between 1 and 100.

maxPages.description: Maximum number of listing pages to scan, from 1 to 50 (default 50). Collection stops earlier once maxResults is reached.

enrichDetails.description: Try product pages and published seller business information for listing rows. Enabled by default; enrichLimit controls how many listing products are checked.

includeOffers.description: Add a separate, billed row for each collected marketplace offer. Product and offer rows count together toward maxResults.

maxResults.description: Most rows for the selected keyword, category, campaign, or product input. Default 70; larger numbers are collected in parts of 70. Product and offer rows count together. mode.description: Choose what to collect, or leave auto to select from the fields you fill. Ranking and category modes need no keyword; review mode needs an item or shop. genreId narrows the selected mode.

itemUrl.description: One item page address, e.g. https://item.rakuten.co.jp/<shop>/<item>/ or https://<shop>.rakuten.co.jp/item/<item>/

shopUrlCode.description: Shop code from the shop address, e.g. rakutenmobile-store in https://www.rakuten.co.jp/rakutenmobile-store/. Alone it lists the shop; with a manage number it opens one item.

manageNumber.description: Item code from the final part of an item page address. Use with shopUrlCode to select one item.

shopId.description: Numeric Rakuten shop identifier. Selects a shop for shop or review mode; use with itemId to select one item.

itemId.description: Numeric Rakuten item identifier. Use with shopId to select one item for item or review mode.

startUrls.description: Rakuten Ichiba search, item, shop, ranking or review page addresses, including shop and item pages on a shop's own subdomain (<shop>.rakuten.co.jp). Each address selects its page type and has its own maxResults allowance.

enrichDetails.description: Add available item-page details to product listings. May increase run time.

enrichReviews.description: Request available full-text reviews as separate billed rows. Review rows and product rows share the same maxResults allowance; a complete review history is not guaranteed.

enrichStock.description: Request available stock and variant information for items. These details may be missing.

enrichShipping.description: Request available item shipping fees and delivery estimates. These details may be missing.

maxResults.description: Maximum rows for each keyword or start URL; a single item, shop, ranking, category or suggestion request counts as one input. Default 70, collected in parts of 70 for larger requests; all row types share the allowance, subject to the run cost cap and the Free plan limit of 200 rows per run.

tools.name: rakuten_com__shops
tools.description: [Rakuten Japan Products Shops and Rankings] Rakuten shop catalog by shopUrlCode. Shop profile and product rows for a Rakuten Ichiba shopUrlCode. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 20 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

shopUrlCode.description: Shop code from the shop address, e.g. rakutenmobile-store in https://www.rakuten.co.jp/rakutenmobile-store/. Alone it lists the shop; with a manage number it opens one item.

startUrls.description: Rakuten Ichiba search, item, shop, ranking or review page addresses, including shop and item pages on a shop's own subdomain (<shop>.rakuten.co.jp). Each address selects its page type and has its own maxResults allowance.

page.description: First search result page to collect, starting at 1.

maxResults.description: Maximum rows for each keyword or start URL; a single item, shop, ranking, category or suggestion request counts as one input. Default 70, collected in parts of 70 for larger requests; all row types share the allowance, subject to the run cost cap and the Free plan limit of 200 rows per run.

tools.name: realtor_com__search
tools.description: [Realtor.com US Homes Sale and Rent] Search US Realtor.com property listings. Retrieve US homes for sale, rent or sold listings filtered by location, property type and price range. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 20 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

location.description: US city and state or ZIP, e.g. 'Austin, TX' or '78701'. Leave empty when you fill in Detail URLs.

detailUrls.description: Realtor.com listing URLs ending with a property identifier such as _M12345-67890; use real listing links, not search pages. Each URL is an input with its own maxResults allowance and takes precedence over location search.

listingType.description: Scrape for-sale listings, rentals, or both.

propertyTypes.description: Optional residential property-type filters (multi-select). Leave empty for all types. Full set: house, condo, townhouse, multi_family, mobile, farm, land, apartment.

propertyType.description: Legacy single property-type filter. Prefer propertyTypes. Merged with propertyTypes when both are set.

minPrice.description: Optional minimum list price or rent in USD.

maxPrice.description: Optional maximum list price or rent in USD.

enrichDetails.description: Add available detail-page information, such as fees, history, photos, and contacts, to search results. Enabled by default; specific listing URLs always fetch details.

maxResults.description: Maximum listings for each location or supplied detail URL (1–200; split across sale and rent when listingType is both). The default is 70. The whole run still stops at the free-plan quota or your maximum charge limit.

tools.name: realtor_com_agents__search
tools.description: [Realtor.com Real Estate Agents Directory] Search US Realtor.com real estate agents. Search real estate agent profiles by city, ZIP or agent name with optional profile enrichment. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

location.description: Enter one US city and two-letter state, such as Austin, TX, or a ZIP code such as 78701; state-only values are not supported. Leaving all target fields empty starts the Austin example with up to 3 rows, at normal run prices.

agentName.description: Optional agent name or surname to narrow the location search, such as Jane Doe. Spaces in the name are treated as hyphens for the search.

isRealtor.description: When enabled, restricts results to agents Realtor.com marks as members (is_realtor).

minPrice.description: Optional minimum listing price filter for agent search. If min is above max, the two are swapped.

maxPrice.description: Optional maximum listing price filter for agent search. If min is above max, the two are swapped.

enrichProfiles.description: Add available profile details, including phones, office information, MLS memberships, and specializations. Details stay in the same agent row without another row charge.

maxResults.description: Maximum agent rows for one location: 1–500, default 70; larger requests are collected in parts of 70, and enrichment stays in the same row. Your maximum run cost can stop delivery earlier; Free plan users are limited to 200 rows per run and 10 runs of this Actor.

tools.name: reddit_com__search
tools.description: [Reddit Posts Comments and Subreddits Data] Search Reddit posts, subreddits and comments. Fetch public Reddit posts by subreddit, search query, preset catalog or post ID with optional comments and community metadata. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

subreddits.description: Subreddit names to scrape (with or without r/). Example: ["forhire", "freelance"]. Fill this, Search Queries, or Subreddit catalog topic — any one is enough. Explicitly pass an empty array (subreddits=[]) with searchQueries for a site-wide Reddit search. Omitting subreddits and all other targets defaults to r/forhire; a searchQueries-only input also runs a site-wide search.

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search. With subreddits set, searches inside each subreddit. With subreddits empty, runs a site-wide Reddit search. If empty while subreddits are set, scrapes the subreddit feed (new/hot/top) without keyword filtering.

subredditCatalog.description: Pick a built-in topic instead of naming subreddits. Its subreddit list is merged with Subreddits (deduplicated). Enough on its own to start a run.

postIds.description: Collect specific posts by id or link instead of a feed: t3_ fullnames, bare ids, or reddit.com/r/<sub>/comments/<id> permalinks. Detail mode returns one row per post with the full post record and is not combined with Subreddits or Search Queries.

maxResults.description: Most rows for each subreddit (or for each search query when no subreddit is given). Default 70; larger numbers are collected in parts of 70. Posts and optional comment, community and user rows share this limit and are billed at the same price per row. The whole run stops at your maximum total charge. Free platform plan: up to 200 rows per run and 10 runs of this Actor (limits set by the Actor developer).

sort.description: How to sort results. 'new' for latest, 'hot' for trending, 'top' for highest scored, 'relevance' for search relevance (only with searchQueries — listing mode falls back to 'new').

timeFilter.description: Time range filter. Applies to 'top' sort and search results.

includeComments.description: Add available comments and nested replies as separate billed rows. Comments share the maxResults limit with posts and other enabled rows; complete threads are not guaranteed.

maxComments.description: Maximum comment rows per post, including available nested replies, when includeComments is enabled. The remaining maxResults limit can reduce this number.

expandCommentSubtrees.description: When includeComments is on, spend up to this many extra requests filling replies that the comment page left out. Each expansion is one request and still counts against maxComments. Set 0 to turn it off.

allowListingFallback.description: Allow an empty top/week subreddit feed to retry as new, without a time restriction. Leave off to keep the requested sort and time range.

includeSubredditMeta.description: Add public details for communities found in collected posts as separate subreddit rows. Each row is billed at the same price and counts toward maxResults.

includeUserMeta.description: Add available public details for post authors as separate user rows, such as karma and account creation time. Each row is billed at the same price and counts toward maxResults.

expandRelatedSubreddits.description: When a subreddits entry names a catalog topic (hiring, programming, housing, tickets, local, classifieds, remote_jobs, startups), expand it into the full subreddit list for that topic. Without this flag a topic token is passed through verbatim.

tools.name: rightmove_com__search
tools.description: [Rightmove UK Property Sale and Rent] Search Rightmove UK property listings. Search UK properties for sale or rent by location slug or Rightmove search URLs. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 20 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

startUrls.description: Rightmove search or property URLs as plain strings in the JSON input editor, not objects with a url key. Search URLs need locationIdentifier; set channel separately, and leave this empty to use location.

location.description: UK place name, such as Edinburgh or Manchester, used when startUrls is empty. Empty JSON input starts a billed example for Edinburgh with up to 3 rows.

channel.description: Use BUY for properties for sale or RENT for rentals. Set this for search URLs as well as location searches; a rental URL does not select RENT automatically.

searchCategory.description: Only residential listings are supported; homes is accepted as an alias. Commercial, overseas, student, new-home and retirement searches are not supported.

maxPages.description: Retained for legacy compatibility: maxItems controls pagination in the current entity-v1 output, and maxPages does not limit pages. Use maxItems to set your per-input row limit.

scrapeDetails.description: Add available property details, such as descriptions, photos and tenure, to search rows. Direct property URLs request details regardless of this setting.

sortType.description: Sort search results by newest listing, highest price, lowest price or oldest listing. Uses the selected sort even when a search URL contains a different sort value.

maxResults.description: Maximum rows for each start URL, or for the location search when URLs are empty; default 70, with larger requests collected in parts of at most 70 rows. The whole run is bounded by your maximum charge; Free-plan users have at most 200 rows per run and 10 total runs.

tools.name: seatgeek_com__events
tools.description: [SeatGeek Events and Tickets] Events by city, performer, venue, category, sport or keyword. Event rows (and performer/venue rows for keyword search). Leave mode on auto to pick the mode from the target you fill. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

mode.description: Choose what to collect, or leave Auto to select the mode from your target fields. Use Discover explicitly when query should filter a discovery list rather than run keyword search.

city.description: Enter a SeatGeek city slug such as nyc, chicago, toronto, montreal or vancouver. This selects city mode when no higher-priority target is filled.

cityTab.description: Filter city events to concerts, sports, theater, festivals, comedy, family or nightlife.

performerSlug.description: Enter the performer or team slug, such as new-york-yankees, to list its events.

venueSlug.description: Enter a venue slug, such as madison-square-garden, to list its events.

categorySlug.description: Enter a category slug such as sports-tickets, concert-tickets or mlb-tickets.

query.description: Enter a keyword for search mode, which can return events, performers and venues. With mode set to discover, this is an optional text filter.

startUrls.description: List SeatGeek event, performer, venue, city or category URLs. The page type is detected for each URL.

maxPages.description: Set how many catalog pages to inspect while finding events or discovery entities. This is not a ticket listing count.

enrichDetails.description: Include venue address and organization details where available. This does not add a phone or email lookup; those contact arrays remain empty.

maxResults.description: Maximum Dataset rows for each listed start/detail URL or event ID; a scalar city, performer, venue, event, category, sports, search, or discover target counts as one input. Default 70. Larger values are collected in parts of 70. Event and ticket-listing rows count together. The run stops at your maximum total charge. Free platform plan: 200 rows per run and 10 runs.

tools.name: seatgeek_com__listings
tools.description: [SeatGeek Events and Tickets] Ticket listings for one or more events. One row per ticket listing (section, row, quantity, price, deal score), event details copied onto each row. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

eventId.description: Enter the numeric SeatGeek event ID, with at least 5 digits. Put a full event link in eventUrl instead.

eventUrl.description: Enter a SeatGeek event URL ending in the event number. The event ID is read from the URL when eventId is not filled.

listingIds.description: Enter a list of numeric SeatGeek event IDs. Despite the field name, these are event IDs, not individual ticket listing IDs.

detailUrls.description: Enter a list of SeatGeek event URLs. These select the same event-detail collection as eventUrl.

listingFilters.description: Filter by minPrice or maxPrice including fees, quantity, sections, markets or deliveryMethods; sort by price, priceDesc or dealScore. quantity must be an available purchase split, and inventoryUnfilteredTotal retains the count before filtering.

minDealScore.description: With includeListings, keep listings whose dealScore meets this threshold from 0 to 100. inventoryUnfilteredTotal retains the inventory count before filtering.

includeSeatMap.description: Include available seating-map information and matching seat geometry. General-admission or missing seats are not assigned invented coordinates.

maxResults.description: Maximum Dataset rows for each listed start/detail URL or event ID; a scalar city, performer, venue, event, category, sports, search, or discover target counts as one input. Default 70. Larger values are collected in parts of 70. Event and ticket-listing rows count together. The run stops at your maximum total charge. Free platform plan: 200 rows per run and 10 runs.

tools.name: seatgeek_com__discover
tools.description: [SeatGeek Events and Tickets] Discover performers, venues, categories or events. Discovery lists of the selected entity type; events discovery accepts city and a date window. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

discoverType.description: Choose the entity type to collect in discover mode. Source availability varies; performerSections also requires a numeric performerId.

query.description: Enter a keyword for search mode, which can return events, performers and venues. With mode set to discover, this is an optional text filter.

city.description: Enter a SeatGeek city slug such as nyc, chicago, toronto, montreal or vancouver. This selects city mode when no higher-priority target is filled.

dateFrom.description: For mode=discover with discoverType=events: only events on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, compared against the event's UTC date). Combined with city, filters server-side via SeatGeek's public API.

dateTo.description: For mode=discover with discoverType=events: only events on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, compared against the event's UTC date; the whole dateTo day is included).

performerId.description: Enter a numeric performer ID when discoverType is performerSections.

maxResults.description: Maximum Dataset rows for each listed start/detail URL or event ID; a scalar city, performer, venue, event, category, sports, search, or discover target counts as one input. Default 70. Larger values are collected in parts of 70. Event and ticket-listing rows count together. The run stops at your maximum total charge. Free platform plan: 200 rows per run and 10 runs.

keyword.description: Search phrase for jobs, company search or people search. Leave all target fields empty for a small billed example run.

keywords.description: Search phrases for jobs, company search or people search. Each phrase has its own maxResults limit and uses the same location and filters.

location.description: City, region or market-wide location to search. If omitted, Australia uses Sydney NSW; the other markets use their whole-market location.

classification.description: Job classification slug to search when keyword is empty, such as information-communication-technology.

workType.description: Filter jobs by full-time, part-time, contract, casual, hybrid or remote work. Leave empty for any work type.

detailUrls.description: Job page links from SEEK, JobsDB or Jobstreet. Each link is a separate input with its own maxResults limit.

jobListingIds.description: Job numbers, such as 81234567. Each number is a separate input; select the market containing the job.

market.description: Select Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong through JobsDB, or Singapore through Jobstreet. Content availability varies by market.

maxPages.description: Page setting for paginated searches, from 1 to 10. More pages may be read to meet maxResults, up to 10 pages.

enrichDetails.description: Add available job descriptions and detail fields to search rows. Enabled by default; enrichment updates the same row without a separate row charge.

sortBy.description: Jobs: ListedDate for newest listings or KeywordRelevance for relevance. Reviews: Date or Helpful; leave empty for the source order.

remote.description: Search remote jobs when workType is empty. A selected workType takes precedence.

domain.description: Optional recognized market host, such as au.seek.com or nz.seek.com. A recognized host takes precedence over market; unknown hosts are ignored.

maxResults.description: Maximum rows per keyword, job link, job ID or company input; default 70, maximum 200. tools.name: seek_com__employers
tools.description: [SEEK Jobs Reviews and Salaries] SEEK company profiles, reviews, salaries and people. Company overview, employee reviews, salaries, culture, company jobs, company search or people search by employer ID, company URL or keyword. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

channel.description: Choose what to collect. Auto selects job search from a keyword, job details from links or IDs, and company overview from a company link or employer ID.

employerId.description: Company number or slug-ID, such as 432600 or seek-432600. Required for company channels unless companyUrl is supplied.

companyUrl.description: SEEK, JobsDB or Jobstreet company page link instead of employerId. Use a link from the selected market.

companyName.description: Company name used to construct a company link when employerId is numeric.

keyword.description: Search phrase for jobs, company search or people search. Leave all target fields empty for a small billed example run.

keywords.description: Search phrases for jobs, company search or people search. Each phrase has its own maxResults limit and uses the same location and filters.

jobTitle.description: Optional role filter for the salaries channel.

market.description: Select Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong through JobsDB, or Singapore through Jobstreet. Content availability varies by market.

maxPages.description: Page setting for paginated searches, from 1 to 10. More pages may be read to meet maxResults, up to 10 pages.

sortBy.description: Jobs: ListedDate for newest listings or KeywordRelevance for relevance. Reviews: Date or Helpful; leave empty for the source order.

domain.description: Optional recognized market host, such as au.seek.com or nz.seek.com. A recognized host takes precedence over market; unknown hosts are ignored.

maxResults.description: Maximum rows per keyword, job link, job ID or company input; default 70, maximum 200. Larger requests are collected in parts of up to 70 where continuation is available; the whole run is capped by your maximum charge, and Free-plan users have a limit of 200 rows per run and 10 runs.

tools.name: seloger_com__search
tools.description: [SeLoger France Property Listings Data] Search SeLoger France property listings. Search French properties by city, transaction channel and property type on SeLoger. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

startUrls.description: SeLoger search, listing, or professional profile URLs. Use this or location; supplied URLs take priority over location-based search settings.

location.description: French city or area to search when startUrls is empty, such as nantes, lyon, or ile-de-france/paris-75000.

channel.description: Choose BUY for sale listings or RENT for rental listings. Applies when searching by location.

propertyType.description: Choose a main-site SeLoger category for a location search. Use all to omit the category filter; this setting does not select a sister-brand website.

maxPages.description: Maximum number of search pages to collect, from 1 to 50. The row limit may stop collection before this page limit is reached.

scrapeDetails.description: Add available descriptions, DPE information, features, and other detail fields to search-result rows. This enriches the existing row rather than adding a separate billed row.

onlySeloger.description: Skip search cards whose listing URLs point outside seloger.com. Set false to allow sister-brand URLs, where extraction may be incomplete.

maxResults.description: Maximum billed rows for each URL, or for the location search when no URLs are supplied; default 70, maximum 500. The whole run also respects the maximum run cost and, on the Free platform plan, a 200-row cap and 10-run limit.

tools.name: shein_com__search
tools.description: [SHEIN Fashion Products Prices and Categories] Search SHEIN products, categories and trending lists. Product and category rows from SHEIN regional storefronts. Verified storefronts: US, DE, FR, AU and BR. Other storefronts (for example UK or MX) can answer 502 source_blocked while the source refuses collection there; nothing is billed for a failed request. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

mode.description: Choose keyword search, category listings, product details, the category tree, or trending products. Auto selects a mode from the target fields you fill.

query.description: Search phrase, such as linen dress. Ignored when keyword or keywords is filled.

keyword.description: Alternative to query for one search phrase. Takes precedence over query when set.

keywords.description: Search phrases to collect in one run; each has its own maxResults limit. If keyword is also set, it runs first.

categoryUrl.description: SHEIN HTTPS category or promotion URL, or a relative path. Use a current address from the selected storefront.

catId.description: Numeric SHEIN category identifier, such as 2223. Category IDs can differ by region or change over time.

categorySlug.description: Category address slug, such as Women-Tops. Pair it with catId or choose a known bucket.

bucket.description: Category shortcut such as women, men, kids, shoes, beauty, sale, new, or just-for-you. In categories mode, it narrows the category tree.

region.description: SHEIN storefront code, such as us, uk, de, fr, ph, or au. Defaults to the US storefront when omitted.

browseCountry.description: Country alias that overrides region when set. For example, US selects us, GB selects uk, and PH selects ph.

currency.description: Optional currency hint, such as USD, PHP, or EUR. Availability depends on the selected storefront.

sort.description: Listing order: recommended, sales, ascending price, descending price, or newest. An empty value uses the site order.

minPrice.description: Minimum listing price in the selected local currency. Must not exceed maxPrice.

maxPrice.description: Maximum listing price in the selected local currency. Must not be below minPrice.

color.description: Optional color filter value from the selected SHEIN storefront. Accepted values can vary by category.

size.description: Optional size filter value from the selected SHEIN storefront. Accepted values can vary by category.

refine.description: Optional SHEIN filter expression, when known. Leave empty if you do not have a category-specific value.

enrichDetails.description: Add available product details, such as sizes, images, and USD prices, to listing rows. Enabled by default; enrichment updates existing rows without a separate row charge.

enrichLimit.description: Maximum listing rows to enrich, from 0 to 50. Defaults to 3; unavailable details remain missing.

includeReviews.description: SHEIN product pages currently carry no review texts, so this returns 0 review rows today and nothing is charged for them. If review texts come back, each review is its own billed row. Kept so existing tasks keep working. Off by default.

expandColors.description: Add color-product rows from available variants when room remains within maxResults. Off by default; each added row is billed, and its details may be reused from the parent product.

page.description: Starting listing page, from 1 to 100. Later pages may be unavailable or return fewer products.

maxPages.description: Legacy page-count setting. It is not a reliable stopping limit for Actor runs; use maxResults and Maximum cost per run to bound collection.

maxResults.description: Maximum delivered and billed rows per keyword; category, product, and category-tree requests each count as one input. Default 70; larger requests continue in parts of up to 70, within the run cost limit and the Free-plan cap of 200 rows per run.

goodsId.description: Numeric SHEIN product identifier, also found after -p- in a product URL.

productUrl.description: SHEIN HTTPS product page containing -p-<number>.html, or a relative product path. Use a current product URL for the chosen region.

currency.description: Optional currency hint, such as USD, PHP, or EUR. Availability depends on the selected storefront.

expandColors.description: Add color-product rows from available variants when room remains within maxResults. Off by default; each added row is billed, and its details may be reused from the parent product.

includeReviews.description: SHEIN product pages currently carry no review texts, so this returns 0 review rows today and nothing is charged for them. If review texts come back, each review is its own billed row. Kept so existing tasks keep working. Off by default.

maxResults.description: Maximum delivered and billed rows per keyword; category, product, and category-tree requests each count as one input. Default 70; larger requests continue in parts of up to 70, within the run cost limit and the Free-plan cap of 200 rows per run.

tools.name: shopee_com__search

fetchMode.description: What to fetch. Leave it on Auto to pick the mode from the fields you fill: a product link or item ID runs Products, a shop ID or username runs Shop profile, a keyword runs Search suggestions. 'Discover feed' returns the market's daily-discover feed and needs no keyword.

keyword.description: Search phrase for suggestions, or for finding a product seed when fetchMode is products. market.description: Shopee country or region to collect from. Select the market that matches your product or shop; available data varies by market and mode.

discoverySource.description: Catalog face used by discover mode.

includeFilterConfig.description: In suggestions mode, include Shopee's search filter configuration in the SEARCH_SIGNALS key-value record. Does not fetch product details.

includeCatTree.description: In suggestions mode, save the available market category tree, including nested categories, to the CATEGORY_TREE record in the default key-value store.

includeSearchFacet.description: In products mode, request category breadcrumbs for up to the first three rows. In shop mode, request the market-level Shopee Mall category list.

maxResults.description: Maximum rows per input, from 1 to 200; defaults to 70 when a target is supplied without a limit. Also accepts maxResults or maxItems; Free-plan users have a 200-row run cap and 10 runs of this Actor, subject to their maximum run charge.

tools.name: shopee_com__shops
tools.description: [Shopee Regional Products Suggestions and Shops] Shopee shop profile or product lookup. Shop profile rows (mode shop) or product detail rows by shopId, shopUsername, itemId or itemUrl. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

shopId.description: Numeric Shopee shop ID. On its own it runs Shop profile; together with Item ID it names a product seed.

shopUsername.description: The shop's username (the part after the Shopee domain in the shop link). Runs Shop profile.

itemId.description: Numeric Shopee item ID. Use it together with Shop ID (or give the product link instead). Runs Products.

itemUrl.description: Shopee product link, such as https://shopee.sg/product/<shopId>/<itemId> or a link ending in -i.<shopId>.<itemId>. Select the matching market and avoid supplying separate IDs with the link.

market.description: Shopee country or region to collect from. Select the market that matches your product or shop; available data varies by market and mode.

maxResults.description: Maximum rows per input, from 1 to 200; defaults to 70 when a target is supplied without a limit. Also accepts maxResults or maxItems; Free-plan users have a 200-row run cap and 10 runs of this Actor, subject to their maximum run charge.

tools.name: skyscanner_net__search
tools.description: [Skyscanner Flights Hotels and Travel Deals Data] Search Skyscanner flights, routes and hotels. Query public Skyscanner flight offers, route deals, hotels and listing details by origin, destination or place. x402 price: $0.0050/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

service.description: Auto chooses a service from your target: hotel or flight link, city identifier, destination name, or route codes, in that order. Select a service explicitly to use a city name for hotels instead of destination deals.

origin.description: Skyscanner origin code for flights, such as bkk. You can enter a route as bkk|sin; if only destination is supplied, the origin is bkk.
