startUrls.description: Yelp search or business page URLs. Each URL has its own maxResults allowance; search URL filters may not be reproduced exactly, so also specify the keyword and location.

bizSlug.description: Business slug, such as joes-pizza-new-york, or a full Yelp business page URL. This target selects business details in Auto mode.

cflt.description: Category alias such as restaurants, dentists or hotels; beauty maps to beautysvc. Category mode may use the fallback keyword ramen even when another keyword is supplied; use a keyword search for more predictable matching.

maxResults.description: Maximum rows per URL, or per single search, detail or company input: default 70, maximum 200. Business and review rows share the allowance; the whole run is also limited by your maximum charge and the Free plan cap of 200 rows.

market.description: Country-site choice for the requested Yelp pages; United States is the default. Availability of businesses, pages and individual fields varies by location.

sortBy.description: Requested result order: recommended, highest rated or most reviewed. The returned ordering may vary.

start.description: Initial search offset; 0 starts at the beginning. The number of results available still depends on the search and page allowance.

maxPages.description: Optional upper bound, from 1 to 20; by default pages follow maxResults. Collection may stop earlier when the row allowance is reached or no new businesses are found.

enrichDetails.description: Add available business details such as opening hours and other business information. Enabled by default; missing details do not guarantee that the business row will be discarded.

includeReviews.description: Add available reviews as separate, equally priced rows. Disabled by default; business and review rows share maxResults for each input.

reviewTerm.description: Not available in this Actor. Changing this field currently does not filter review text.

reviewLimit.description: Not available in this Actor. Changing this field currently does not change the review allowance; use maxResults to limit all rows.

reviewOffset.description: Not available in this Actor. Changing this field currently does not select a review offset.

includePhotos.description: Not available in this Actor. Changing this field currently does not request additional photos.

photoLimit.description: Not available in this Actor. Changing this field currently does not change the number of photos.

includePresentation.description: Not available in this Actor. Changing this field currently does not request page layout information.

includeMobileSubsurfaces.description: Adds extra per-business sections (offers, services, pricing, posts, portfolio, claim info, sponsored, call-to-action) under a mobile field on each business row. Off by default.

mobileSubsurfaces.description: Which extra sections to add when Include extra business sections is on. Leave empty for all. Allowed: offer_campaigns, service_offering, pricing, posts, business_portfolio, claim_info, sponsored_gems, objective_cta.

communityQuestionsFirst.description: Not available in this Actor. Changing this field currently does not change the number of community questions.

registerDevice.description: Leave unchanged. Used only by the developer for testing.

phoneNumber.description: Phone reverse lookup is not available in this Actor. Use a keyword, business slug or business URL instead.

phoneCountry.description: Phone reverse lookup is not available in this Actor. This setting does not enable it.

tools.name: zillow_com__search
tools.description: [Zillow Trulia and HotPads Real Estate] Search Zillow, Trulia and HotPads listings. Search US residential listings by city, ZIP, detail URLs and price/bed/bath filters across Zillow Group brands. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

location.description: US area to search, such as Austin, TX; Zillow also accepts recognized ZIP, county, and neighborhood locations. Use city and state for Trulia and HotPads.

locations.description: Additional US areas to search in the same run; location is included too when filled. maxResults applies separately to each area.

detailUrls.description: Property or building page URLs from zillow.com, trulia.com, or hotpads.com, with mixed brands allowed. When set, location search is skipped and brand is detected from each URL; maxResults applies separately to each URL.

maxPages.description: Legacy page preference, not a page limit for current collection. Use maxResults to limit delivered rows.

brand.description: Brand for location searches; all includes the supported paths for each brand and does not guarantee equal coverage. Ignored when detailUrls is filled.

channel.description: Overrides listingType when filled: Zillow supports sale, rent, and sold; Trulia supports sale and rent; HotPads returns rentals only. The specialty options marked not available must not be selected.

listingType.description: Used when channel is empty: both requests sale and rent, while all also requests sold listings. Coverage depends on brand; the specialty options marked not available must not be selected.

geoType.description: This hint is not applied to current searches. Leave auto selected.

propertyTypes.description: Zillow search only: house, condo, townhouse, apartment, land, or multi_family. Not applied to Trulia, HotPads, or direct property URLs.

saleStatuses.description: Not applied to current searches. Leave empty.

minBeds.description: Minimum bedroom count for Zillow searches only. Leave empty for no limit; not applied to Trulia, HotPads, or direct property URLs.

maxBeds.description: Maximum bedroom count for Zillow searches only. Leave empty for no limit; not applied to Trulia, HotPads, or direct property URLs.

minBaths.description: This filter is not applied to current searches. Leave empty and filter the exported rows when the corresponding value is available.

maxBaths.description: This filter is not applied to current searches. Leave empty and filter the exported rows when the corresponding value is available.

minPrice.description: Minimum price in USD for Zillow searches only. Leave empty for no limit; not applied to Trulia, HotPads, or direct property URLs.

maxPrice.description: Maximum price in USD for Zillow searches only. Leave empty for no limit; not applied to Trulia, HotPads, or direct property URLs.

minSqft.description: This filter is not applied to current searches. Leave empty and filter the exported rows when the corresponding value is available.

maxSqft.description: This filter is not applied to current searches. Leave empty and filter the exported rows when the corresponding value is available.

minLotSqft.description: This filter is not applied to current searches. Leave empty and filter the exported rows when the corresponding value is available.

maxLotSqft.description: This filter is not applied to current searches. Leave empty and filter the exported rows when the corresponding value is available.

minYearBuilt.description: This filter is not applied to current searches. Leave empty and filter the exported rows when the corresponding value is available.

maxYearBuilt.description: This filter is not applied to current searches. Leave empty and filter the exported rows when the corresponding value is available.

maxHoa.description: This filter is not applied to current searches. Leave empty and filter the exported rows when the corresponding value is available.

maxDaysOnMarket.description: This filter is not applied to current searches. Leave empty and filter the exported rows when the corresponding value is available.

loanAmount.description: Mortgage lookups are not available. Leave empty.

creditBand.description: Mortgage lookups are not available. Leave empty.

ltv.description: Mortgage lookups are not available. Leave empty.

loanType.description: Mortgage lookups are not available. Leave empty.

enrichDetails.description: Add available property and contact details to search rows. Enabled by default; it can take longer but does not create a separate billed row.

expandUnits.description: Individual building-unit expansion is not available. Leave false; apartment buildings are returned as listing rows.

maxResults.description: Maximum rows per location or property URL, shared across its brands and listing types; default 70, with larger requests collected in parts of 70. The run also stops at your maximum cost or applicable free-plan limits.

tools.name: zoopla_co_uk__search
tools.description: [Zoopla UK Listings Sold Prices and Agents] Search Zoopla UK listings and sold prices. Query Zoopla UK properties by area name, postcode or detail URLs across sale, rent and sold price channels. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 10 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

area.description: UK place: a Zoopla place slug or free-text name, for example Islington, London; London; N1; or Didsbury, Manchester. Fill this or Detail URLs. Each area search is one input with its own Max results allowance. Overseas mode also accepts country slugs such as spain or france. Leave both empty to get a small example run (3 Sheffield sale listings).

postcode.description: A full UK postcode such as "SE24 9BD". Required when Search type is Postcode addresses; returns one row per address with its UPRN.

detailUrls.description: Zoopla listing links, for example https://www.zoopla.co.uk/for-sale/details/12345678/ (also to-rent, new-homes, commercial and overseas details links). Each URL is one input with its own Max results allowance. When filled, Area is not searched.

searchType.description: Which Zoopla listings to collect: for sale, to rent, new homes, listing details, sold house prices, estate agents, commercial or overseas. Map pins are not available yet. Postcode mode looks up every address on a UK postcode.

enrichDetails.description: Add available property-detail or agent-profile fields, including prices, addresses and agency phone numbers, to the same row. Off by default; when enabled, maxPages is limited to 3.

enrichAgents.description: When detail enrichment is on, also fetch the listing's agency branch to add the agent phone, email and address to the row's lead fields.

priceMin.description: Optional minimum property listing price in GBP.

priceMax.description: Optional maximum property listing price in GBP.

bedsMin.description: Optional minimum bedroom count for property searches.

bedsMax.description: Optional maximum bedroom count for property searches.

radius.description: Optional search radius in miles, from 0 to 40.

sort.description: Order property search results by recommendation, newest listings, highest price, lowest price or most reduced. Leave empty to use the site default.

maxPages.description: Page limit for listing, sold-price and agent searches, from 1 to 8. Enabling enrichDetails reduces this limit to at most 3; the row limit still applies.

maxResults.description: Maximum Dataset rows for each detail URL or area search (1–200; default 70). Larger values are collected in parts of up to 70 rows. All row types count together. The whole run stops at your maximum total charge. Free platform plan users: up to 200 rows per run and 10 runs total.

tools.name: zumper_com__search
tools.description: [Zumper US Rentals and Property Listings] Search Zumper US rental listings. Query rental apartments and homes across US cities with listing type, price range and detail options. x402 price: $0.0030/row USDC (max 20 rows; 0 rows / errors are never charged).

location.description: City and state to search, e.g. 'Tucson, AZ' or 'Phoenix, AZ'. Fill in this or Start URLs. If both are empty, the run collects a few example listings for Tucson, AZ.

startUrls.description: Listing detail URLs from zillow.com or zumper.com to scrape directly. When filled, search is skipped and Location is ignored.

sites.description: Sites to scrape. Zillow supports For Sale and Recently Sold; Zumper supports For Rent. When both are selected, the listing type automatically chooses the compatible site.

listingType.description: Filter by listing type. 'For Sale' and 'Recently Sold' use Zillow; 'For Rent' uses Zumper. If no selected site offers this type, the filter is skipped.

propertyType.description: Request a property category for searches. Leave as Any to avoid this filter; support can vary by source.

minPrice.description: Minimum sale price or monthly rent in USD for searches. Optional.

maxPrice.description: Maximum sale price or monthly rent in USD for searches. Optional.

scrapeDetails.description: Add available detail-page information to search rows. If enrichDetails is also supplied, its value takes precedence; set both switches to false to disable search enrichment.

enrichDetails.description: Add available detail-page information, including contact fields, to search rows. This setting takes precedence over scrapeDetails when both are supplied.

includeFees.description: Zumper location searches only. Add a fee breakdown for the first few listings, each as its own row with rowType 'fee'. Each row is charged like a listing.

includeBuildings.description: Zumper location searches only. Add building details for the first few listings, each as its own row with rowType 'building'. Each row is charged like a listing.

includeHoods.description: Zumper location searches only. Add the neighborhoods inside the searched location, each as its own row with rowType 'hood'. Each row is charged like a listing.

maxResults.description: Maximum listing rows for the location or for each start URL. Zillow and Zumper share one location's allowance. The whole run also stops at your maximum total charge. Free platform plan: up to 200 rows per run and 10 runs.
